# Snippy

> A Manifest V3 browser extension (Chrome and Firefox) for capturing UI/UX
> feedback on any website - comments, screenshots and captured page elements,
> with annotations, organized into a session, exported as a self-contained
> HTML report.

No backend and no site-side integration required - a reviewer clicks the
toolbar icon on any tab and a slide-out panel appears. The panel is React +
TypeScript on the Recursica design system, bundled by Vite.

## Reference documentation

- [README](README.md): What this is, how to build it, how to load it in
  Chrome/Firefox, and the local development scripts.
- [ARCHITECTURE](ARCHITECTURE.md): Injection/lifecycle model, the
  shadow-root styling model, the storage data model, the report format,
  the build, release and CI, and the migration discipline required for any
  data-shape change.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): Rules for AI agents making changes to this codebase -
  read this and ARCHITECTURE.md before planning a change.

## Layout

- `src/manifest.chrome.json`, `src/manifest.firefox.json` - Per-browser MV3
  manifests. Differ in their `background` block and in Firefox's
  `browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`.
- `src/background.js` - Service worker: injects `content.js` on toolbar
  click, captures screenshots on request from the content script.
- `src/content/` - The panel (React + TypeScript): entry and mount,
  components, session state, screenshot and element capture, annotations,
  and the downloaded report's HTML generation. The pure logic sits in
  `lib/` (`annotations`, `capture`, `captureFrame`, `element`,
  `environment`, `format`, `ids`, `links`, `page`, `pen`, `recursica`,
  `report`, `shortcuts`, `storage`, `types`). Bundled into `content.js`
  and re-injected fresh on every toolbar click.
- `src/report.css` - Styles the downloaded report only. Inlined into
  `content.js` at build time, not loaded at runtime.
- `src/ai-report-instructions.txt` - Hidden, AI-readable instructions
  explaining the report's structure, also inlined at build time.
- `vite.config.mts` - Bundles the panel into one classic-script
  `content.js`, and scopes every stylesheet to the panel's shadow root.
- `scripts/make-icons.mjs` - Generates the four icon sizes in
  `src/icons/` from one source PNG (`npm run icons -- <source.png>`).
  `src/icons/source.svg` is the vector source of the icon.
- `scripts/package-extension.mjs` - Zips `dist/chrome` and `dist/firefox`
  into `release-zips/snippy-<browser>-v<version>.zip` (`npm run package-extension`).
- `scripts/lint-staged.config.cjs`, `.husky/` - The pre-commit hook that
  runs Prettier, ESLint and the type check on staged files.
- `eslint.config.mjs`, `.prettierignore` - Lint and format configuration.
- `build.js` - Runs the Vite build, then copies `content.js`,
  `background.js` and the icons into `dist/chrome` and `dist/firefox`,
  pairing each with its own manifest.
- `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.node.json` - Type checking for the panel and
  for the Vite config.
- `dist/` - Build output (git-ignored). Load `dist/chrome` or
  `dist/firefox` as an unpacked/temporary extension to run it.
- `.changeset/` - Changesets config; this package is private and never
  published to npm, so versioning/changelog tracking is the point, not a
  registry publish.
- `.github/workflows/` - `pull-request.yml` (lint + build on every PR) and
  `release.yml` (Changesets' Version-Packages-PR flow).
